description: Search or list messages in a connected mailbox. Gmail accepts Gmail query syntax (from:x newer_than:7d has:attachment); Microsoft 365 accepts KQL; other IMAP servers accept from:, to:, subject: and free text.

account.description: Which connected mailbox to use (its label from mailroom_accounts). Optional when only one is connected or a default is saved in memory.

folder.description: Folder: inbox (default), sent, drafts, trash, junk, archive, all, or a folder name.

query.description: Search text. Leave empty to list the newest messages.

since.description: Only messages after this ISO date, or a shorthand like 7d, 36h, 2w.

name: mailroom_search
